text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected — billing ledger and usage-display diverge for a subset of customers (accounts with daily spikes). Auto-severity: P1. Paging oncall.
Maya (oncall): I got paged, jumping in. Observed: UI usage shows 0 for some accounts but ledger has nonzero rows. Repro rate ~2% of active customers.
Ethan (sre): I see errors in metering worker logs around write-back to the aggregator: 
```
ERROR AggregateWriter failed to upsert key=acct_12345 shard=12: duplicate_key_conflict
stack: ...
```
Maya (oncall): Thanks. Priya, any billing downstream jobs impacted (invoice generation)?
Priya (billing): Invoice pipeline runs nightly. If ledger rows exist, invoices should be ok, but CS will see wrong usage in the portal. Need to confirm reconciliation tolerances.
Carlos (cs): Customers are already DMing support. Some are seeing recent usage disappear in the dashboard. We should prepare a short status page + CS template.
Zoe (incident-manager): Action list: 1) Mitigate live UI display (cache layer) 2) Fix aggregator write path or apply fallback 3) Customer comms draft and status page 4) Handoff at 16:00 UTC if not resolved. Assigning Ethan and Maya.
Maya (oncall): Mitigation idea: force the dashboard to read directly from ledger (read-through) instead of cache for affected accounts. That should restore display but may add latency.
Ethan (sre): I can deploy a small config flip: set UI_CACHE_TTL=0 for shard range. Doing canary on shard 12.
incident-bot: Deploy started by @Ethan (sre) — canary shards: 12-13. Logs streaming at https://internal/logs/1971256789
Ethan (sre): Canary looks good for shard 12: previously blank panels now show ledger rows. No obvious errors. Rolling to additional affected shards.
Priya (billing): Confirming invoice pipeline is still consuming ledger insert stream; no backlog spike yet. I'll watch for duplicates if we do write-path retries.
Carlos (cs): CS template draft: "We are aware of an issue affecting usage display in the dashboard for a small subset of accounts. There is no impact to billing or invoices; visible usage may be temporarily inconsistent. We're actively recovering displays and will update in 1h." Thoughts?
Zoe (incident-manager): Good start. Add estimated customers impacted (~2%), mention workaround (view invoice/usage export) and link to support form. Also include escalations for enterprise customers.
Maya (oncall): Note: root cause looks like a recent change to aggregator dedupe logic that incorrectly classified some late-arriving events as already-applied, dropping them from the display index.
Ethan (sre): Minimal fix: revert dedupe change and re-run a small backfill for the last 24h for affected shards. Backfill plan: 1) snapshot keys, 2) idempotent upsert, 3) monitor error rate. Running tests now.
Zoe (incident-manager): Status page draft (short): "Investigating — We are seeing inconsistent usage display for a small subset of customers. No billing impact. Mitigation in progress (forcing dashboard to read ledger). Next update in 60 minutes." Approve?
Priya (billing): Approve. Add contact for urgent billing concerns.
Carlos (cs): I'll paste CS message in Intercom and enable a banner for affected customers.
Ethan (sre): Backfill dry-run completed on staging, errors <0.1%. Scheduling production backfill now. ETA 20m.
Maya (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall (if not resolved): issue_id=INC-1971256789, affected_shards=12-18, mitigation=UI read-through enabled, next_step=run backfill and monitor ledger->display consistency metric (metric: display_reconcile_rate).
status-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1971256789 — state=investigating. Template and CS banner queued.
Carlos (cs): Notifying top 10 enterprise customers directly via account reps as a precaution.
Ethan (sre): Backfill started at 1971258000. Monitoring consumer lag and duplicate suppression. I'll post metrics in 10m.
Maya (oncall): If shift change happens before resolution, I'll hand off to @Alex (oncall-2) with the notes above.
Zoe (incident-manager): Great coordination. Keep updates short and post any customer-visible changes. Finalize status page once backfill completes and display reconciliation >99.9%.
incident-bot: Incident severity remains P1. Next automated check-in in 15m.
